import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CoherentWitness

/-!
# Existence of the Amitsur-coherent Čech witness (sub-brick ζ2·i)

This file proves the coherent-witness step of the (C1) étale-separatedness assembly
(`informal/c1-etale-separatedness-assembly.md`, ζ2 "global-unit correction" route):

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_coherentCechWitness`: in ζ1's setting — `C` proper,
  geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced over a field `k`, a tower
  `k → A → B` of algebras, `L` a Čech Picard class on `(C ⊗ Spec A).left` and `γ` a unit
  cocycle on a pointed cover `𝒩` of `Spec B` whose class pulls back from `L`
  (`p_B^* N = (C ◁ Spec (ofId A B))^* L`) — there exists an Amitsur-coherent Čech
  witness (`AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentCechWitness`) for ζ1's class equality
  `q₁^* N = q₂^* N` over `Spec (B ⊗[A] B)`.

## The global-unit correction argument

ζ1 (`Over.cechPicMap_tensorInl_eq_tensorInr`) gives `q₁^* N = q₂^* N`; the `mk`-calculus
of `Scheme.CechPic` produces a witness cochain `θ₀` on a common refinement `𝒲` of the two
pullback covers. Its Amitsur defect `ω := (f₂₃^♯ θ₀) ⋅ (f₁₂^♯ θ₀) / (f₁₃^♯ θ₀)` over the
triple tensor has trivial Čech coboundary — the three coface pullbacks of the defining
relation of `θ₀` telescope through the simplicial coincidences (ζ2·P) — so `ω` glues to a
global unit `ω̄` (P1). Upstairs, the hypothesis produces a witness `α` on the curve
product `X_B` relating `p_B^♯ γ` to the `L`-restriction; the comparison
`p₂^♯ θ₀ / (u₁^♯ α / u₂^♯ α)` on `X_{B ⊗ B}` has trivial coboundary — the `L`-terms cancel
by the diagonal coincidence — and glues to a global unit `ψ`, which descends through the
projection to `χ ∈ Γ(Spec (B ⊗[A] B), ⊤)ˣ` (P2b). Pulling everything to `X_{B ⊗ B ⊗ B}`
and using that the upstairs Amitsur telescope of the comparison cancels **exactly** (the
six insertion composites collapse pairwise), `p₃^♯ ω̄` equals `p₃^♯` of the Amitsur
coboundary of `χ`; injectivity of `p₃^♯` on global units gives
`ω̄ = (f₂₃^♯ χ) ⋅ (f₁₂^♯ χ) / (f₁₃^♯ χ)`. Hence `θ := θ₀ / χ` is still a witness (global
units have trivial Čech coboundary) and its Amitsur defect is `ω̄` divided by the Amitsur
coboundary of `χ`, i.e. `1` — the coherent witness.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
  TopologicalSpace CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

/-! ## The existence theorem

The commutative-group telescopes (`telescope_congr`, `telescope_mul_div`,
`coboundary_ratio_congr`, `div_mul_div_eq_of_mul_div`) and the global-unit pullback lemma
`units_map_appTop_comp` used below are reusable infrastructure living in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CoherentWitness`. -/

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
  [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))

-- Spec-side objects and maps
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "Sq" => (overSpec k (B ⊗[A] B)).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "Scb" => (overSpec k (B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "q₁" => (Over.overSpecMap (tensorInl (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "q₂" => (Over.overSpecMap (tensorInr (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "f₁₂" => (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₂ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "f₁₃" => (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "f₂₃" => (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₂₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
-- product-side objects and maps
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "XB" => (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "Xq" => (C ⊗ overSpec k (B ⊗[A] B)).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "Xcb" => (C ⊗ overSpec k (B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "pB" => (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "p₂" => (snd C (overSpec k (B ⊗[A] B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "p₃" => (snd C (overSpec k (B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B)))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "u₁" => (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorInl (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "u₂" => (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorInr (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "w₁₂" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₂ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "w₁₃" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "w₂₃" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₂₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "cg" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A B).restrictScalars k)).left

-- The proof is one long chain of cover bookkeeping (three pointed covers on three schemes
-- and their pullbacks); each step is cheap but there are many of them.
set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
/-- **Existence of the Amitsur-coherent Čech witness (sub-brick ζ2·i)** of the (C1)
étale-separatedness assembly, by the global-unit correction argument. In ζ1's setting —
if the class of `γ` on `Spec B` pulls back, on the curve product, from the class `L` on
`C ⊗ Spec A` — then ζ1's class equality `q₁^* N = q₂^* N` over `Spec (B ⊗[A] B)` admits a
witness cochain which is Amitsur-coherent over the triple tensor. -/
theorem Over.exists_coherentCechWitness
    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    (L : ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).left).CechPic)
    (𝒩 : ((overSpec k B).left).PointedCover) (γ : ((overSpec k B).left).unitsCocycle 𝒩)
    (h : Scheme.CechPic.map (snd C (overSpec k B)).left (Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒩 γ.class)
        = Scheme.CechPic.map
            (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A B).restrictScalars k)).left L) :
    Nonempty (CoherentCechWitness k A B 𝒩 γ) := by
  classical
  -- ### ζ1: the two coprojection pullbacks of `N` agree
  have hz1 := Over.cechPicMap_tensorInl_eq_tensorInr C L (Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒩 γ.class) h
  -- ### Step A: extract a witness cochain `θ₀` on a common refinement `𝒲`
  rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_mk, Scheme.CechPic.map_mk, Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsH1_class,
    Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsH1_class] at hz1
  obtain ⟨𝒲, hW₁, hW₂, eW⟩ := Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp hz1
  have eW' : (((q₁).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res fun x ↦ homOfLE (hW₁ x)).IsCohomologous
      (((q₂).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res fun x ↦ homOfLE (hW₂ x)) :=
    (OneCocycle.class_eq_iff _ _).mp eW
  obtain ⟨θ₀, hθ₀⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp eW'
  -- the coboundary relation for `θ₀`, in `unitsAppLE` normal form
  have hdown : ∀ x y : Sq,
      (Sq).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ 𝒲.opens x) (θ₀ x)
        * (q₁).unitsAppLE (𝒩.opens ((q₁).base x) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((q₁).base y))
            (𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
            ((q₁).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₁ x))
              (inf_le_right.trans (hW₁ y)))
            (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ ((q₁).base x) ((q₁).base y))
      = (q₂).unitsAppLE (𝒩.opens ((q₂).base x) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((q₂).base y))
            (𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
            ((q₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₂ x))
              (inf_le_right.trans (hW₂ y)))
            (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ ((q₂).base x) ((q₂).base y))
        * (Sq).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (θ₀ y) := by
    intro x y
    have h1 : (Sq).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ 𝒲.opens x) (θ₀ x)
          * Scheme.unitsEvInf
              (((q₁).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res fun z ↦ homOfLE (hW₁ z)) x y
        = Scheme.unitsEvInf
              (((q₂).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res fun z ↦ homOfLE (hW₂ z)) x y
          * (Sq).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (θ₀ y) := hθ₀ x y
    rw [Scheme.res_unitsEvInf, Scheme.res_unitsEvInf,
      Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf,
      Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map] at h1
    exact h1
  -- ### Step D: the upstairs witness `α` on the curve product `X_B`
  induction L using Scheme.CechPic.ind with | _ ℒ l =>
  induction l using Quot.ind with | _ lam =>
  rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_mk, Scheme.CechPic.map_mk] at h
  obtain ⟨𝒜, hA₁, hA₂, eA⟩ := Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp h
  have eA' : (((pB).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res fun v ↦ homOfLE (hA₁ v)).IsCohomologous
      (((cg).pullbackUnitsCocycle lam).res fun v ↦ homOfLE (hA₂ v)) :=
    (OneCocycle.class_eq_iff _ _).mp eA
  obtain ⟨α, hα₀⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp eA'
  -- the coboundary relation for `α`, in `unitsAppLE` normal form
  have hup : ∀ v w : XB,
      (XB).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒜.opens v ⊓ 𝒜.opens w ≤ 𝒜.opens v) (α v)
        * (pB).unitsAppLE (𝒩.opens ((pB).base v) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((pB).base w))
            (𝒜.opens v ⊓ 𝒜.opens w)
            ((pB).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hA₁ v))
              (inf_le_right.trans (hA₁ w)))
            (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ ((pB).base v) ((pB).base w))
      = (cg).unitsAppLE (ℒ.opens ((cg).base v) ⊓ ℒ.opens ((cg).base w))
            (𝒜.opens v ⊓ 𝒜.opens w)
            ((cg).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hA₂ v))
              (inf_le_right.trans (hA₂ w)))
            (Scheme.unitsEvInf lam ((cg).base v) ((cg).base w))
        * (XB).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α w) := by
    intro v w
    have h1 : (XB).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒜.opens v ⊓ 𝒜.opens w ≤ 𝒜.opens v) (α v)
          * Scheme.unitsEvInf
              (((pB).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res fun z ↦ homOfLE (hA₁ z)) v w
        = Scheme.unitsEvInf
              (((cg).pullbackUnitsCocycle lam).res fun z ↦ homOfLE (hA₂ z)) v w
          * (XB).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α w) := hα₀ v w
    rw [Scheme.res_unitsEvInf, Scheme.res_unitsEvInf,
      Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf,
      Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map] at h1
    exact h1
  -- ### Step B: the Amitsur defect `ω` of `θ₀` has trivial Čech coboundary
  have hle₂₃ : ∀ z : Scb,
      (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ≤ (f₂₃) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒲.opens ((f₂₃).base z) :=
    fun _ ↦ inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hle₁₂ : ∀ z : Scb,
      (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ≤ (f₁₂) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒲.opens ((f₁₂).base z) :=
    fun _ ↦ inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hle₁₃ : ∀ z : Scb,
      (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ≤ (f₁₃) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒲.opens ((f₁₃).base z) :=
    fun _ ↦ inf_le_right
  set ω : ∀ z : Scb, Γ(Scb, (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z)ˣ := fun z ↦
    (f₂₃).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((f₂₃).base z)) ((amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z) (hle₂₃ z)
        (θ₀ ((f₂₃).base z))
      * (f₁₂).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((f₁₂).base z)) ((amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z) (hle₁₂ z)
        (θ₀ ((f₁₂).base z))
      / (f₁₃).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((f₁₃).base z)) ((amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z) (hle₁₃ z)
        (θ₀ ((f₁₃).base z)) with hω
  have hωcompat : ∀ z z' : Scb,
      (Scb).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
          (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ⊓ (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z'
            ≤ (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z) (ω z)
        = (Scb).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (ω z') := by
    intro z z'
    -- pull the witness relation back along the three cofaces
    have r₂₃ := Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_coboundary_rel (f₂₃) (q₁) (q₂) (𝒞 := 𝒲) θ₀
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b')
      (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      (fun x y ↦ (q₁).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₁ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₁ y)))
      (fun x y ↦ (q₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₂ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₂ y)))
      hdown z z' (O := (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ⊓ (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z')
      ((f₂₃).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hle₂₃ z)) (inf_le_right.trans (hle₂₃ z')))
    have r₁₂ := Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_coboundary_rel (f₁₂) (q₁) (q₂) (𝒞 := 𝒲) θ₀
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b')
      (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      (fun x y ↦ (q₁).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₁ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₁ y)))
      (fun x y ↦ (q₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₂ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₂ y)))
      hdown z z' (O := (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ⊓ (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z')
      ((f₁₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hle₁₂ z)) (inf_le_right.trans (hle₁₂ z')))
    have r₁₃ := Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_coboundary_rel (f₁₃) (q₁) (q₂) (𝒞 := 𝒲) θ₀
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b')
      (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      (fun x y ↦ (q₁).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₁ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₁ y)))
      (fun x y ↦ (q₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₂ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₂ y)))
      hdown z z' (O := (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z ⊓ (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens z')
      ((f₁₃).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hle₁₃ z)) (inf_le_right.trans (hle₁₃ z')))
    -- collapse the six composite maps onto the three insertions
    rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_pair_congr_hom
      (Over.overSpecMap_left_face₁₂_inr (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      z z' _] at r₁₂
    rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_pair_congr_hom
      (Over.overSpecMap_left_face₁₂_inl (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)).symm
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      z z' _] at r₁₃
    rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_pair_congr_hom
      (Over.overSpecMap_left_face₁₃_inr (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      z z' _] at r₁₃
    simp only [hω, map_div, map_mul, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
    exact telescope_congr r₂₃ r₁₂ r₁₃
  -- ### Step C: glue `ω` to a global unit `ω̄` (P1)
  obtain ⟨ωbar, hωbar⟩ := Scheme.exists_global_unit_of_compatible ω hωcompat
  -- ### Step E: the comparison `p₂^♯ θ₀ / (u₁^♯ α / u₂^♯ α)` has trivial coboundary
  set 𝒞₂ : (Xq).PointedCover :=
    (𝒲.pullback (p₂)) ⊓ (𝒜.pullback (u₁) ⊓ 𝒜.pullback (u₂)) with h𝒞₂
  have hCp : ∀ s : Xq, 𝒞₂.opens s ≤ (p₂) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒲.opens ((p₂).base s) :=
    fun _ ↦ inf_le_left
  have hCu₁ : ∀ s : Xq, 𝒞₂.opens s ≤ (u₁) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒜.opens ((u₁).base s) :=
    fun _ ↦ inf_le_right.trans inf_le_left
  have hCu₂ : ∀ s : Xq, 𝒞₂.opens s ≤ (u₂) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒜.opens ((u₂).base s) :=
    fun _ ↦ inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right
  set ψ₀ : ∀ s : Xq, Γ(Xq, 𝒞₂.opens s)ˣ := fun s ↦
    (p₂).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((p₂).base s)) (𝒞₂.opens s) (hCp s) (θ₀ ((p₂).base s))
      * ((u₂).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((u₂).base s)) (𝒞₂.opens s) (hCu₂ s) (α ((u₂).base s))
        / (u₁).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((u₁).base s)) (𝒞₂.opens s) (hCu₁ s) (α ((u₁).base s)))
    with hψ₀
  have hψcompat : ∀ s s' : Xq,
      (Xq).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒞₂.opens s ⊓ 𝒞₂.opens s' ≤ 𝒞₂.opens s) (ψ₀ s)
        = (Xq).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (ψ₀ s') := by
    intro s s'
    -- pull the witness relation back along `p₂`, and the upstairs one along `u₁, u₂`
    have rt := Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_coboundary_rel (p₂) (q₁) (q₂) (𝒞 := 𝒲) θ₀
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b')
      (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      (fun x y ↦ (q₁).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₁ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₁ y)))
      (fun x y ↦ (q₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hW₂ x))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hW₂ y)))
      hdown s s' (O := 𝒞₂.opens s ⊓ 𝒞₂.opens s')
      ((p₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hCp s)) (inf_le_right.trans (hCp s')))
    have ra₁ := Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_coboundary_rel (u₁) (pB) (cg) (𝒞 := 𝒜) α
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ ℒ.opens b ⊓ ℒ.opens b')
      (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf lam b b')
      (fun v w ↦ (pB).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hA₁ v))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hA₁ w)))
      (fun v w ↦ (cg).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hA₂ v))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hA₂ w)))
      hup s s' (O := 𝒞₂.opens s ⊓ 𝒞₂.opens s')
      ((u₁).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hCu₁ s)) (inf_le_right.trans (hCu₁ s')))
    have ra₂ := Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_coboundary_rel (u₂) (pB) (cg) (𝒞 := 𝒜) α
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ ℒ.opens b ⊓ ℒ.opens b')
      (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf lam b b')
      (fun v w ↦ (pB).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hA₁ v))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hA₁ w)))
      (fun v w ↦ (cg).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hA₂ v))
        (inf_le_right.trans (hA₂ w)))
      hup s s' (O := 𝒞₂.opens s ⊓ 𝒞₂.opens s')
      ((u₂).le_preimage_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hCu₂ s)) (inf_le_right.trans (hCu₂ s')))
    -- identify the composite maps: the base square and the diagonal coincidence
    rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_pair_congr_hom
      (Over.snd_left_naturality C (Over.overSpecMap (tensorInl (A := A) (B := B)))).symm
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      s s' _] at rt
    rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_pair_congr_hom
      (Over.snd_left_naturality C (Over.overSpecMap (tensorInr (A := A) (B := B)))).symm
      (fun b b' ↦ 𝒩.opens b ⊓ 𝒩.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf γ b b')
      s s' _] at rt
    rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_pair_congr_hom (Over.whiskerLeft_inl_ofId C)
      (fun b b' ↦ ℒ.opens b ⊓ ℒ.opens b') (fun b b' ↦ Scheme.unitsEvInf lam b b')
      s s' _] at ra₁
    simp only [hψ₀, map_div, map_mul, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
    exact coboundary_ratio_congr rt ra₁ ra₂
  -- ### Step F: glue to a global unit `ψ` (P1 upstairs) and descend to `χ` (P2b)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Scheme.exists_global_unit_of_compatible ψ₀ hψcompat
  set χ : Γ(Sq, ⊤)ˣ := (Over.unitsSndTopEquiv C (B ⊗[A] B)).symm ψ with hχdef
  have hχ : Units.map (p₂).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom χ = ψ := by
    rw [hχdef, ← Over.unitsSndTopEquiv_apply]
    exact (Over.unitsSndTopEquiv C (B ⊗[A] B)).apply_symm_apply ψ
  -- ### Step G: `ω̄` is the Amitsur coboundary of `χ`
  have hglob : ωbar
      = Units.map (f₂₃).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom χ
        * Units.map (f₁₂).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom χ
        / Units.map (f₁₃).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom χ := by
    apply Over.appTop_units_injective C (B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B))
    set 𝒟 : (Xcb).PointedCover :=
      ((amitsurCover 𝒲).pullback (p₃))
        ⊓ ((𝒞₂.pullback (w₂₃) ⊓ 𝒞₂.pullback (w₁₂)) ⊓ 𝒞₂.pullback (w₁₃)) with h𝒟
    have hDp : ∀ x : Xcb,
        𝒟.opens x ≤ (p₃) ⁻¹ᵁ (amitsurCover 𝒲).opens ((p₃).base x) :=
      fun _ ↦ inf_le_left
    have hD₂₃ : ∀ x : Xcb, 𝒟.opens x ≤ (w₂₃) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒞₂.opens ((w₂₃).base x) :=
      fun _ ↦ inf_le_right.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
    have hD₁₂ : ∀ x : Xcb, 𝒟.opens x ≤ (w₁₂) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒞₂.opens ((w₁₂).base x) :=
      fun _ ↦ inf_le_right.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)
    have hD₁₃ : ∀ x : Xcb, 𝒟.opens x ≤ (w₁₃) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒞₂.opens ((w₁₃).base x) :=
      fun _ ↦ inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right
    apply Scheme.global_unit_ext (𝒰 := 𝒟)
    intro x
    -- the pullback of a face-pullback of `χ` along `p₃` is a `w`-pullback of `ψ`
    have factor : ∀ (φS : Scb ⟶ Sq) (φX : Xcb ⟶ Xq)
        (hcomm : φX ≫ (p₂) = (p₃) ≫ φS),
        (Xcb).unitsRestrict (le_top : 𝒟.opens x ≤ ⊤)
            (Units.map (p₃).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
              (Units.map φS.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom χ))
          = φX.unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top ψ := by
      intro φS φX hcomm
      calc (Xcb).unitsRestrict (le_top : 𝒟.opens x ≤ ⊤)
            (Units.map (p₃).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
              (Units.map φS.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom χ))
          = ((p₃) ≫ φS).unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top χ := by
            rw [units_map_appTop_comp, ← Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_top,
              Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
        _ = (φX ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top χ :=
            Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_congr_hom hcomm.symm _ _ χ
        _ = φX.unitsAppLE ((p₂) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) (𝒟.opens x) le_top
              ((p₂).unitsAppLE ⊤ ((p₂) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) le_rfl χ) := by
            rw [Scheme.unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE]
        _ = φX.unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top ψ := by
            rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_top, hχ]
    -- the pullback of `ω̄` along `p₃`, in canonical `w ≫ p₂` form
    have hLHS : (Xcb).unitsRestrict (le_top : 𝒟.opens x ≤ ⊤)
          (Units.map (p₃).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom ωbar)
        = (w₂₃ ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((w₂₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
            ((hD₂₃ x).trans ((w₂₃).preimage_mono (hCp ((w₂₃).base x))))
            (θ₀ ((w₂₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x))
          * (w₁₂ ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((w₁₂ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₁₂ x).trans ((w₁₂).preimage_mono (hCp ((w₁₂).base x))))
              (θ₀ ((w₁₂ ≫ (p₂)).base x))
          / (w₁₃ ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((w₁₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₁₃ x).trans ((w₁₃).preimage_mono (hCp ((w₁₃).base x))))
              (θ₀ ((w₁₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) := by
      have h1 := congrArg
        ((p₃).unitsAppLE ((amitsurCover 𝒲).opens ((p₃).base x)) (𝒟.opens x) (hDp x))
        (hωbar ((p₃).base x))
      rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h1
      simp only [hω, map_mul, map_div, Scheme.unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE] at h1
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_top, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
      refine h1.trans ?_
      refine congrArg₂ (· / ·) (congrArg₂ (· * ·) ?_ ?_) ?_
      · exact Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_section_congr_hom
          (Over.snd_left_naturality C
            (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₂₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)))).symm
          (fun b ↦ 𝒲.opens b) θ₀ x _
      · exact Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_section_congr_hom
          (Over.snd_left_naturality C
            (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₂ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)))).symm
          (fun b ↦ 𝒲.opens b) θ₀ x _
      · exact Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_section_congr_hom
          (Over.snd_left_naturality C
            (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)))).symm
          (fun b ↦ 𝒲.opens b) θ₀ x _
    -- the `w`-pullbacks of `ψ`, in canonical (three-insertions) form
    have hR₂₃ : (w₂₃).unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top ψ
        = (w₂₃ ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((w₂₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
            ((hD₂₃ x).trans ((w₂₃).preimage_mono (hCp ((w₂₃).base x))))
            (θ₀ ((w₂₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x))
          * ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₂₃ x).trans ((w₂₃).preimage_mono (hCu₂ ((w₂₃).base x))))
              (α ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₂)).base x))
            / (w₂₃ ≫ (u₁)).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₁)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₂₃ x).trans ((w₂₃).preimage_mono (hCu₁ ((w₂₃).base x))))
              (α ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₁)).base x))) := by
      have h1 := congrArg
        ((w₂₃).unitsAppLE (𝒞₂.opens ((w₂₃).base x)) (𝒟.opens x) (hD₂₃ x))
        (hψ ((w₂₃).base x))
      rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h1
      simp only [hψ₀, map_mul, map_div, Scheme.unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE] at h1
      exact h1
    have hR₁₂ : (w₁₂).unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top ψ
        = (w₁₂ ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((w₁₂ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
            ((hD₁₂ x).trans ((w₁₂).preimage_mono (hCp ((w₁₂).base x))))
            (θ₀ ((w₁₂ ≫ (p₂)).base x))
          * ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₁)).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₁)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₂₃ x).trans ((w₂₃).preimage_mono (hCu₁ ((w₂₃).base x))))
              (α ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₁)).base x))
            / (w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₁₂ x).trans ((w₁₂).preimage_mono (hCu₁ ((w₁₂).base x))))
              (α ((w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)).base x))) := by
      have h1 := congrArg
        ((w₁₂).unitsAppLE (𝒞₂.opens ((w₁₂).base x)) (𝒟.opens x) (hD₁₂ x))
        (hψ ((w₁₂).base x))
      rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h1
      simp only [hψ₀, map_mul, map_div, Scheme.unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE] at h1
      refine h1.trans ?_
      refine congrArg₂ (· * ·) rfl (congrArg₂ (· / ·) ?_ rfl)
      exact Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_section_congr_hom
        (Over.whiskerLeft_face₁₂_inr (k := k) (A := A) (B := B) C)
        (fun b ↦ 𝒜.opens b) α x _
    have hR₁₃ : (w₁₃).unitsAppLE ⊤ (𝒟.opens x) le_top ψ
        = (w₁₃ ≫ (p₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens ((w₁₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
            ((hD₁₃ x).trans ((w₁₃).preimage_mono (hCp ((w₁₃).base x))))
            (θ₀ ((w₁₃ ≫ (p₂)).base x))
          * ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₂)).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₂)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₂₃ x).trans ((w₂₃).preimage_mono (hCu₂ ((w₂₃).base x))))
              (α ((w₂₃ ≫ (u₂)).base x))
            / (w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)).unitsAppLE (𝒜.opens ((w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)).base x)) (𝒟.opens x)
              ((hD₁₂ x).trans ((w₁₂).preimage_mono (hCu₁ ((w₁₂).base x))))
              (α ((w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)).base x))) := by
      have h1 := congrArg
        ((w₁₃).unitsAppLE (𝒞₂.opens ((w₁₃).base x)) (𝒟.opens x) (hD₁₃ x))
        (hψ ((w₁₃).base x))
      rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h1
      simp only [hψ₀, map_mul, map_div, Scheme.unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE] at h1
      refine h1.trans ?_
      refine congrArg₂ (· * ·) rfl (congrArg₂ (· / ·) ?_ ?_)
      · exact Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_section_congr_hom
          (Over.whiskerLeft_face₁₃_inr (k := k) (A := A) (B := B) C)
          (fun b ↦ 𝒜.opens b) α x _
      · exact Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_section_congr_hom
          (Over.whiskerLeft_face₁₂_inl (k := k) (A := A) (B := B) C).symm
          (fun b ↦ 𝒜.opens b) α x _
    -- assemble: both sides restrict to the same Amitsur combination
    simp only [map_mul, map_div]
    rw [hLHS,
      factor (f₂₃) (w₂₃) (Over.snd_left_naturality C
        (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₂₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)))),
      factor (f₁₂) (w₁₂) (Over.snd_left_naturality C
        (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₂ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)))),
      factor (f₁₃) (w₁₃) (Over.snd_left_naturality C
        (Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)))),
      hR₂₃, hR₁₂, hR₁₃]
    exact (telescope_mul_div _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
  -- ### Final assembly: `θ := θ₀ / χ` is a coherent witness (correction lemma)
  refine CoherentCechWitness.nonempty_of_defect_eq_coboundary 𝒩 γ 𝒲 hW₁ hW₂ θ₀ hdown χ
    (fun z ↦ ?_)
  change ω z = _
  rw [← hωbar z, hglob]

end AlgebraicGeometry
